base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your SAP system without the service path.

options.tooltip:
**Base URL** of your SAP system, **without** the service path.

**Examples:**
- `https://my-sap-server.com`
- `https://sandbox.api.sap.com/s4hanacloud`

You can find available services at the [SAP API Hub](https://api.sap.com/).

catalog_path.title: Catalog Path (Optional)
catalog_path.description: Path to SAP Service Catalog for browsing services.

options.tooltip:
Path to the **SAP Service Catalog** for browsing available OData services.

**Example:** `http/keboola/catalog`

Leave empty if you don't use a service catalog.

auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description: Select the authentication method for your SAP system.

options.tooltip:
**Authentication method** for connecting to your SAP system.

| Method | Use case |
|---|---|
| **Basic** | Username & password — most common |
| **OAuth 2.0** | Client credentials flow |
| **API Key** | SAP API Hub or custom gateways |

[SAP authentication docs](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_AS_ABAP_FOR_SOH_740/68bf513362174d54b58cddec28794093/e6f7c2fad4bd453eb5ee75b5d2685885.html)
Your **SAP system username** for basic authentication.

Your **SAP system password**.

The value is **encrypted** and stored securely — it will never be displayed in plain text.

**API key** for authentication.

The value is **encrypted** and stored securely.

Get your key at [api.sap.com](https://api.sap.com/).

api_key_header_name.title: API Key Header Name
api_key_header_name.description: HTTP header name for the API key.

options.tooltip:
**HTTP header name** used to send the API key.

**Common values:**
- `APIKey` — SAP API Hub (default)
- `X-API-Key` — custom gateways

**OAuth 2.0 token endpoint** URL for client credentials flow.

This is the URL where the component requests an access token using your Client ID and Client Secret.
Your **OAuth 2.0 Client ID** for the client credentials grant.

Your **OAuth 2.0 Client Secret**.

The value is **encrypted** and stored securely.

Override **timeout**, **retries**, and **SSL settings**.

Leave empty to use defaults.

timeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum wait time for a server response.

options.tooltip:
**Maximum wait time** for a SAP server response in seconds.

**Recommended values:**
- `60` — standard extractions (default)
- `120`+ — large or complex extractions

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts on transient failures.

options.tooltip:
Number of **automatic retry attempts** on transient failures (network issues, timeouts).

**Recommended:** `3` (default)

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL Certificates
verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates for HTTPS connections.

options.tooltip:
Verify **SSL/TLS certificates** for HTTPS connections.

**Disable only** for development environments with self-signed certificates.

pagination_defaults.title: Default Pagination Settings
pagination_defaults.description: Override default pagination for all entities.

options.tooltip:
Override the **default page size** and **record limit** for all entities.

Leave empty to use defaults:
- Page size: `1000`
- Max records: unlimited

page_size.title: Default Page Size
page_size.description: Records per page for all entities.

options.tooltip:
**Records per page** for all entities. Can be overridden per entity in row config.

**Recommended:** `1000` (default)

[OData query docs](https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#queryData)

max_records.title: Default Max Records
max_records.description: Maximum records to fetch per entity (0 = unlimited).

options.tooltip:
**Maximum records** to fetch per entity.

- `0` = **unlimited** (default)
- Set a limit for testing or cost control
